assessment.manualHint: You can choose to reuse this content after reviewing it. Recorded views or a high engagement percentage alone do not establish that repeating it will perform well.
assessment.benchmarkReason: A comparison needs matching metrics, audience, paid or organic status, and measurement age. A reliable minimum evidence rule for reuse has not yet been established.
assessment.referenceHint: Published averages from the provider’s brand sample, shown for context. They are not minimum view counts or evidence that this post should be repeated. Formats and formulas differ; these references do not qualify a post for a recommendation.
assessment.noReference: No verified reference is available here for this platform.
assessment.confirm: I have reviewed every caption and its media and links. The content remains useful and accurate, with no expired offers, outdated instructions, or claims that depend on a past event. I will update or pause it when that changes.
assessment.xManual: X occurrences use manual publishing reminders. Review and adapt the content before posting; recurring identical or substantially similar automated posts are restricted by X.
